With x=exp(u) and g(u)=exp(u/2)f(exp(u)), the quadratic form becomes convolution with k(t)=(2cosh(t/2))^(−p). Its integral is Beta(p/2,p/2). Cauchy-Schwarz bounds each translation correlation; normalized long interval indicators give sharpness. Equality would force a nonzero L2 function to be invariant under a nonzero translation, impossible.
